The signed-permutation group orbit support is the decreasing absolute-coordinate dot product. Positive prefix-vector decompositions imply ≥1/√d, and strict equality forces a singleton prefix paired with a full prefix, giving exactly sparse/uniform optimizers. Planar C_N nearest-orbit angular separation ≤π/N and D_N source on reflection axis give κ=cos(π/N); elementary O(2) finite-group classification gives C_M uniquely maximizing at order≤M. Taylor derivative at c=1 gives deficit π²t/[2(t+2)M²]+O(M^-4). Independently evaluated Φ for H2/H4/H8 and C1/C2/C4 and M=100,1000,10000 to check coefficient convergence; bounded calculations corroborate not prove all groups/dimensions.
